title: Unemployment rate
description: Unemployment rate for the civilian labor force.
evidence: Both the unemployment rate, at 4.4 percent, and the number of unemployed people, at 7.6 million, changed little in February.

title: Unemployed people
description: Number of unemployed people in the civilian labor force.
evidence: Both the unemployment rate, at 4.4 percent, and the number of unemployed people, at 7.6 million, changed little in February.

title: Labor force participation rate
description: Share of the civilian noninstitutional population in the labor force.
evidence: Both the labor force participation rate, at 62.0 percent, and the employment-population ratio, at 59.3 percent, changed little in February.

title: Employment-population ratio
description: Employed people as a share of the civilian noninstitutional population.
evidence: Both the labor force participation rate, at 62.0 percent, and the employment-population ratio, at 59.3 percent, changed little in February.

title: Change in total nonfarm payroll employment
description: Seasonally adjusted month-over-month change in total nonfarm payroll employment.
evidence: Total nonfarm payroll employment edged down by 92,000 in February, and the unemployment rate changed little at 4.4 percent.

title: Long-term unemployed people
description: People jobless for 27 weeks or more.
evidence: The number of long-term unemployed (those jobless for 27 weeks or more) changed little at 1.9 million in February.

title: Long-term unemployed share of unemployed
description: Long-term unemployed as a share of all unemployed people.
evidence: The long-term unemployed accounted for 25.3 percent of all unemployed people in February.

title: People working part time for economic reasons
description: People who wanted full-time work but worked part time because hours were reduced or full-time work was unavailable.
evidence: The number of people employed part time for economic reasons decreased by 477,000 to 4.4 million in February.

title: Consumer Price Index, all items, monthly change
description: Seasonally adjusted monthly change in CPI-U for all items.
evidence: The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 0.3 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in February.

title: Consumer Price Index, all items, 12-month change
description: Unadjusted 12-month change in CPI-U for all items.
evidence: Over the last 12 months, the all items index increased 2.4 percent before seasonal adjustment.

title: Consumer Price Index excluding food and energy, 12-month change
description: 12-month change in CPI-U excluding food and energy.
evidence: The all items less food and energy index rose 2.5 percent over the year.

title: Personal income
description: Current-dollar personal income monthly growth rate.
evidence: Personal income increased $113.8 billion (0.4 percent at a monthly rate) in January.

title: Disposable personal income
description: Disposable personal income monthly growth rate.
evidence: Disposable personal income (DPI)—personal income less personal current taxes—increased $219.9 billion (0.9 percent).

title: Personal consumption expenditures
description: Current-dollar personal consumption expenditures monthly growth rate.
evidence: Personal consumption expenditures (PCE) increased $81.1 billion (0.4 percent).

title: Real personal consumption expenditures
description: Real PCE monthly growth rate.
evidence: Real PCE increased $17.0 billion (0.1 percent at a monthly rate) in January.

title: PCE price index
description: Monthly change in the PCE price index.
evidence: From the preceding month, the PCE price index for January increased 0.3 percent.

title: PCE price index excluding food and energy
description: Year-over-year change in the PCE price index excluding food and energy.
evidence: Excluding food and energy, the PCE price index increased 3.1 percent from one year ago.

title: Goods and services trade deficit
description: Seasonally adjusted U.S. goods and services trade deficit.
sourceName: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Census Bureau
evidence: The goods and services deficit was $54.5 billion in January, down $18.4 billion from $72.9 billion in December, revised.

title: Exports of goods and services
description: Seasonally adjusted exports of goods and services.
sourceName: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Census Bureau
evidence: Exports: $302.1 Billion +5.5%.

title: Imports of goods and services
description: Seasonally adjusted imports of goods and services.
sourceName: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Census Bureau
evidence: Imports: $356.6 Billion –0.7%.

title: Exports of goods
description: Exports of goods on the balance-of-payments basis.
sourceName: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Census Bureau
evidence: Exports of goods increased $14.6 billion to $195.5 billion in January.

title: Imports of services
description: Imports of services on the balance-of-payments basis.
sourceName: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Census Bureau
evidence: Imports of services increased $0.2 billion to $79.3 billion in January.

title: Privately-owned housing units authorized by building permits
description: Seasonally adjusted annual rate of privately-owned housing units authorized by permits.
evidence: Privately-owned housing units authorized by building permits in September were at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1,400,000.

title: Privately-owned housing starts
description: Seasonally adjusted annual rate of privately-owned housing starts.
evidence: Privately-owned housing starts in September were at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1,221,000.

title: Privately-owned housing completions
description: Seasonally adjusted annual rate of privately-owned housing completions.
evidence: Privately-owned housing completions in September were at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1,192,000.

title: Sales of new single-family houses
description: Seasonally adjusted annual rate of new single-family home sales.
sourceName: U.S. Census Bureau and Department of Housing and Urban Development
evidence: Sales of new single-family houses in August 2026 were at a seasonally-adjusted annual rate of 684,000.

title: Retail and food services sales
description: Advance seasonally adjusted retail and food services sales, not adjusted for price changes.
evidence: Advance estimates of U.S. retail and food services sales for September 2026 ... were $745.0 billion, up 0.8 percent from the previous month.

title: Retail and food services sales year-over-year change
description: Year-over-year change in advance retail and food services sales.
evidence: Advance estimates of U.S. retail and food services sales for September 2026 ... were $745.0 billion, up 0.8 percent (±0.4 percent) from the previous month, and up 6.3 percent (±0.5 percent) from September 2025.
